verdict.rationale: Docs confirm an employee-facing "My Equity" portal listing grants and enabling option exercise (docs-29, docs-26), but there is no explicit evidence of vesting-progress visualization, strike-price display, or personal what-if/outcome value modeling for the employee view — scenario modeling documented (docs-10, docs-11) appears to be an admin/finance tool for financing rounds, not an employee outcome calculator. Missing for 10: vesting progress tracker in employee portal, strike price shown to employee, personal equity value scenario/what-if tool for employees.
